front: key light from the front along the lens axis, even facial illumination
front-left: key from front-left of the subject, natural interview-style modeling
front-right: key from front-right of the subject, mirrored modeling of front-left
side left: side light from camera-left, strong dimension and texture
side right: side light from camera-right, strong dimension and texture
above: top light from above, deeper eye sockets, fashion editorial drama
above-front: high front key, butterfly-adjacent wrap with soft under-eye shadow
below: under-light from below, unusual horror or experimental mood
back: light primarily from behind the subject, rim and separation
three-point (key+fill+rim): classic three-point setup with distinct key, soft fill, and separating rim
